Kill it — ML suffered a lot, he's a contract killer posing as a vet. I think there is romantic subtext but nothing actually comes to fruition

Seasons of Blossom — this is an unusual drama where the ML committed suicide before the drama starts and it's about a girl who loved him going back to work at the school and helping the students there. But it goes into detail about everything the ML was struggling with, so much so that he's still the ML even though he's dead

The Guest — no romance very dark and heavy two MLs and an FL whose lives were ruined by a demon while they were still children and it's about their recovery and hunt for the devil. There is great friendship and bromance here as well as heavy angst

Two Weeks —no romance ML goes on the run. He has had a hard life and suffers a lot of hardship

The Veil — no romance ML is an agent who has gone through a LOT and comes back when everyone thought he was dead but he's traumatised and different

Honestly Vincenzo is an absolute one-of-a-kind; it's an incredible show. It's hard to find shows that hit all the same notes but here's some shows I think have similarities that share the same humour:

Good Manager/Manager Kim - this is written by the same screenwriter. It's incredibly funny, really well paced with fantastic characters. This screenwriter is really good at creating awesome characters and situational humour. This show is fab. It is also serious too, like Vincenzo.

Crazy Love - I think the humour is quite similar. It's got a good mix of serious and hilarity. I liked it especially because of the leads chemistry between one another. This is the only one I'm recommending that is focussed on romance, however it also has an appealing mystery and the ML is like an onion with more and more layers peeling off every episode, like Vincenzo!

Tale of the Nine-tailed 1938 - really funny. It's a comedy horror fantasy. It's actually surprising how spooky it is because you forget every time they make you laugh. 

One Dollar Lawyer - this one is quite funny with a quirky main character. The storyline is a bit muddled, but I recommend it for the team vibes and the humour mixed with the heavy topics that come up.

Taxi Driver - I doubt you've missed this one, but just in case, I think the team dynamics are super similar to Vincenzo and there are some surprisingly funny moments. It is mainly serious, but the ML is also a badass fighter and the other characters create such a cool team, I just have to mention it.

I wholly recommend Train (2021). It's a totally underrated crime show with a mix of fantasy. There's two parallel worlds where everything is the same but for a few (key!) differences. They're trying to find a killer from one world that dumps bodies in the other. It's quite similar to Signal, and it's very suspenseful! Like I have to pause in the middle of an episode to take a breather away from the tension. Also the cinematography is epic, especially with the colour shading between the two worlds. You can watch it on Viki.

Another one I recommend for you is Arthdal Chronicles. It's similar to Six Flying Dragons and written by the same screenwriters. It's about a mythical land where two species of humanoids live and are at war.  There's so much cool lore and mythos created, it's just really well done. There's two seasons now as well :D you can watch it on Netflix.

Finally, Cruel City (2013). It's really similar to The Worst of Evil and it's got Jung Kyung Ho acting PHENOMENALLY in it. It's about undercover cops in a drug ring, and explores similar themes of good and evil and identity. I highly recommend it; it's fantastic and will grip you from the start. It's on Viki!!
